card.name: Start of a drug name or new sentence
card.fires_on: The first piece of a capitalized word that begins a drug name (brand or generic) or a new sentence, such as Sp, Con, C, IN or tr. It appears in drug-label warnings, often after 'including' or a period.

modes.description: First piece of a drug name after 'including' or 'with'.
